triples.tail_surface: Remove Allen screws (77) between coupling part motor (71) and spacer (72) and the screws (76), which hold the flexible coupling (74) to the coupling part pump (70). It is not necessary to remove the screws (also 76) which hold the flexible coupling to the spacer. After a vertical pull downwards take out the spacer (72).
